capsules.faq.own-blend.question: Can I use my own blend with UNO?
capsules.faq.own-blend.answer: Yes. Fill a reusable capsule with your compatible blend. One reusable self-fill capsule comes with UNO. A trial set of disposable self-fill capsules (a few pieces) — included free of charge. Branded capsules and extra self-fill packs are optional.
capsules.faq.four-zones.question: Reusable Pro capsule — fill with your own blend
capsules.faq.four-zones.answer: A reusable self-fill capsule with four separate zones for your own compositions. It is aluminium with a ceramic lid. It can be ordered separately; availability is confirmed individually.
capsules.faq.smart-qr.question: RAMSIDER Pro filled capsules — scan the QR label
capsules.faq.smart-qr.answer: RAMSIDER filled capsules contain blends based on tea leaf, tobacco leaf or herbs. Each blend is linked to its temperature program. Scan the QR label with your phone, remove both labels and insert the capsule. The program adapts heating to the blend to support consistent flavour.
capsules.faq.phone.question: Do I need a phone to use UNO?
capsules.faq.phone.answer: Basic operation starts directly from the UNO screen without a phone or registration. A phone is used to scan the QR on a branded capsule label and link its blend to the matching temperature program.
capsules.faq.ranges.question: Are nicotine-free and tea capsules available?
capsules.faq.ranges.answer: A nicotine-free range and a tea capsule have been developed. Serial production is being prepared. The current range and availability for your order are confirmed individually.
